title: Continuity 5x3
texts: Easy climbing - 5 mins on, 3 mins rest

The goal of this workout is to maintain an increased level of blood flow to the forearms without creating a high level of muscle pump.

Find an easy route, circuit or section wall where you can climb for 5 minutes without stopping.  You should not feel pumped during this session as the intensity should remain low. 
 
Complete this 5 minute rep 3 times in total and rest for 3 minutes between each set.  Circuit boards and auto belays are useful during this session.
